title: Channel 11 Media Inquiry — Patient Numbers and Death Count

fields.message: How many victims has Ottawa River received and how many are dead? We have a family saying their relative is critical and nobody will tell them anything. Is it true the hospital computers are down? We want to report names.
fields.deadline: Going LIVE at 20:00 — we need a statement NOW

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to manage public messaging under time pressure. Watch for attempts to share patient details or confirm fatalities before the AOC and CPO have cleared the message.
